scenes.title: The plan
scenes.vo: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.
scenes.cap: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.

scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Log it in the DeFi Protocol Due Diligence Tracker (Notion) and tick a box only when the step is evidenced, not assumed. First, Mechanism: what the contracts do; users, assets, incentives. Next, Cash flow: real fees and interest versus emissions. Then, Dependencies: oracles, bridges, admin keys, stablecoins, other protocols. Also, Solvency: collateral quality, liquidation design, bad-debt paths. On top of that, Evidence: explorers, audits, governance, independent data.
scenes.cap: Log it in the DeFi Protocol Due Diligence Tracker (Notion) and tick a box only when the step is evidenced, not assumed. First, Mechanism: what the contracts do; users, assets, incentives. Next, Cash flow: real fees and interest vs emissions. Then, Dependencies: oracles, bridges, admin keys, stablecoins, other protocols. Also, Solvency: collateral quality, liquidation design, bad-debt paths. On top of that, Evidence: explorers, audits, governance, independent data.

scenes.title: Key ideas (cont.)
scenes.vo: And finally, Exit: exact unwind, gas, slippage, approvals to revoke.
scenes.cap: And finally, Exit: exact unwind, gas, slippage, approvals to revoke.

scenes.title: Worked example
steps: Fees are real (borrow demand $2M/yr), but one collateral uses a thin-market…
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. "Protocol Y (lending, Arbitrum). Risk: Medium. Fees are real (borrow demand $2M a year), but one collateral uses a thin-market oracle and upgrades have a 24h timelock. Verdict: supply stablecoins only, cap at 10% of the DeFi book, alert on queued upgrades."

Verdict states size, conditions and exit
